item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud drag po mtshon cha 'khor lo las sbyin sreg rgyal bsen kun phung
item.coloph: gzhung don gtsor bzhag 'di nyid bsgrigs pa 'dis/ skal ldan slob ma'i (mas) nye bar rab bskul nas/ rgyal rong g.yung 'dzin bdag gis legs par bsgrigs/ 'gal ba gang mchis drin chen sprul sku dang*/ yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / bka' skyong srung ma'i tshogs la mthol zhing bshags/ de ltar bkod pa nus mthu dpal brten nas/ sems can las 'tshe rgyal bsen 'byung po kun/ sku gsum me lha'i zhal du thim pa dang*/ gnod bya gnod byed mu mtha' bral ba'i ngang / bdag gzhan don kun myur du 'grub par shog/
